lean.statement:
theorem result
    {Omega : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Omega] (mu : Measure Omega) (N : ℕ)
    (feature : Fin N → Omega → ℝ) (label : Omega → ℝ)
    (hfeature : ∀ i, MemLp (feature i) 2 mu) (hlabel : MemLp label 2 mu) :
    Integrable (fun omega => ((N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, feature i omega - label omega) ^ 2) mu ∧
    (∫ omega, ((N : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, feature i omega - label omega) ^ 2 ∂mu) =
      ‖(N : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i, (hfeature i).toLp (feature i) - hlabel.toLp label‖ ^ 2
approved_definition_context: MemLp at exponent2 means genuine L2 membership. toLp is the equivalence class of the displayed scalar function under the stated measure. Sums range over the full finite index type.
